item.title: Utah House GOP pitches a more than $10M plan to require by-mail ballots be returned in person with ID
item.description: The Republican majority in the Utah House is pushing a plan for the second year in a row to require Utahns to return their by-mail ballots in person and show ID to vote.

item.title: Stranded kayaker rescued out of Virgin River Gorge near Elephant Arch
item.description: A 44-year-old man was rescued out of Virgin River Gorge near Elephant Arch after becoming stranded while kayaking.

item.title: Midvale man sentenced to federal prison for producing CSAM during visit to the Philippines
item.description: A Midvale man who used to run princess-themed events for children has been sentenced to federal prison for producing child sexual abuse material (CSAM) in the Philippines.

item.title: Southern Utah biologists battle wildfire risk with plant-killing drones
item.description: Biologists are using a new technique to increase their efficiency in mitigating wildfire risk at Red Cliffs Desert Reserve: invasive-plant-killing aerial drones.

item.title: Water runs murky in South Salt Lake amidst increased sediment in water system
item.description: South Salt Lake residents are experiencing some murky water as the city announced an increased amount of sediment in the city's water system.

item.title: Weber State professor discovers new species in Great Salt Lake, pointing to greater biodiversity than previously thought
item.description: Alongside her colleagues, a Weber State University professor has discovered a new species of roundworm within the Great Salt Lake, indicating that the lake might be more biodiverse than previously thought.

item.title: 15-year-old reported missing out of Kaysville
item.description: Police are searching for a 15-year-old who has been reported missing out of Kaysville.

item.title: Company CEO responds to carbon monoxide poisoning that left three clients dead, says driver's actions "not normal"
item.description: The Chief Executive Officer of the company whose driver left three disabled adults in an idling van in West Valley Friday, leading to fatal carbon monoxide poisonings, told ABC4 News that the driver's actions that day were "not normal."

item.title: Fire at Salt Lake City women's shelter prompts evacuation
item.description: A fire broke out at the Geraldine E. King Women's Resource Center on Monday night, prompting an evacuation.

item.title: Bill that would require law enforcement to impound vehicles of unlicensed drivers passes House
item.description: A bill that would require law enforcement to impound vehicles of unlicensed drivers has passed the House, amidst criticism from House Democrats.
